description.en: On a hot, dry day, a thirsty crow finds a tall pitcher with a little water at the bottom, and a clever idea, one pebble at a time.
description.vi: Vào một ngày nắng khô, chú Quạ khát nước tìm thấy chiếc bình cao chỉ còn ít nước dưới đáy, và một ý tưởng thông minh, từng viên sỏi một.

origin: Aesop’s fable, retold in English and Vietnamese.

characters.name: Crow
characters.look: glossy indigo-black crow with a blue-violet sheen, bright curious amber eye and a slightly ruffled crest

characters.name: the pitcher
characters.look: tall narrow-necked terracotta clay pitcher with a cream wavy band, standing by a garden wall

artDirection.mood: Sunny, still and thoughtful; a quiet puzzle with a happy splash.
artDirection.setting: Sun-baked flagstone path beside a low whitewashed garden wall, scattered smooth pebbles, a few potted herbs.
artDirection.light: Bright high summer sun, crisp short shadows, cool shade only inside the pitcher.
motifs: terracotta pitcher with a cream wave band
round smooth pebbles in a counting row

cover.prompt: a glossy indigo-black crow perched on the rim of a tall terracotta pitcher holding a round pebble in its beak, pebbles in a row on a sunlit stone path

pages.prompt: a crow flying low over a sun-baked flagstone path on a hot summer day, dry cracked puddle spots, a shimmering heat haze
sentences: On a hot summer day, a thirsty crow flew over a sunny stone path.
Vào một ngày hè nóng bức, chú Quạ khát nước bay ngang qua con đường lát đá đầy nắng.
He looked everywhere for water, but every puddle had dried up.
Quạ tìm khắp nơi, nhưng vũng nước nào cũng đã khô cạn.

pages.prompt: the crow landing beside a tall terracotta pitcher by a whitewashed garden wall, peering into its narrow neck, a cutaway hint of a little water far below
sentences: At last, he spotted a tall clay pitcher beside a garden wall.
Cuối cùng, Quạ nhìn thấy một chiếc bình đất cao bên bức tường vườn.
But the water was right at the bottom, and his beak could not reach it.
Nhưng nước chỉ còn một ít dưới đáy, mỏ Quạ không sao chạm tới.

pages.prompt: the crow pushing against the heavy pitcher with his chest, then sitting on the wall thinking, head tilted
sentences: Crow tried to tip the pitcher over, but it was far too heavy.
Quạ thử đẩy cho bình đổ, nhưng bình nặng quá.
So he sat on the wall and thought very hard.
Thế là Quạ đậu lên bức tường, ngẫm nghĩ thật lâu.

pages.prompt: the crow picking up a smooth round pebble from the path in his beak, other pebbles scattered nearby, dropping one into the pitcher with a little splash
sentences: Then he noticed the little pebbles scattered along the path.
Rồi Quạ chợt để ý những viên sỏi nhỏ nằm rải rác trên đường.
He picked one up in his beak and dropped it into the pitcher. Plink!
Quạ ngậm một viên sỏi, thả vào trong bình. Tõm!

pages.prompt: a cutaway view of the pitcher filling with pebbles and the water line rising, the crow carrying another pebble, a counting row of pebbles on the path
sentences: One pebble, two pebbles, ten pebbles, twenty.
Một viên, hai viên, mười viên, rồi hai mươi viên.
With every pebble, the water rose a little higher.
Cứ mỗi viên sỏi rơi xuống, nước lại dâng lên một chút.

pages.prompt: the crow happily drinking from the brimming pitcher, water sparkling at the rim, feathers fluffed, sunny garden wall behind
sentences: At last, the cool water reached the top, and Crow drank and drank.
Cuối cùng, nước mát dâng lên tận miệng bình, Quạ uống thỏa thích.
He fluffed his feathers and cawed a happy thank-you to the little pebbles.
Quạ xù lông, kêu “quà quạ” thật vui, như để cảm ơn những viên sỏi nhỏ.
